title: First jobs and playing with older men like Gassum
summary: He cannot recall his first job but played with older men, including a banjoist Gassum's band at 12 or 13.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Do you remember your very first job?

No, my very first job. I never thought about that. My first job. Where was my first job? You know, I can't think about my really first job. What band might be with the kids that played with you? At that time, no, when I was playing, I used to play with older men. I was playing that good.

You know? Yeah. As a matter of fact, I don't know if you all know, Gassum played banjo? I've heard the name. Well, Gassum was the banjo. I was playing with his band at one time, and I think I was about 12 or 13 years old.
